## What you did
- Fixed the flaky `test_acs_rejects_expired_assertion`: it slept 2.1s against a 3s clock-skew allowance, so rejection depended on timing; all three sleeping ACS tests now use freezegun — 50/50 green, suite ~2s faster [1].
- Cleared ruff 0.8 and mypy across `kestrel/auth`: a missing Issuer or Subject now returns a 401 instead of crashing into a 500 [1].
- Split the 900-line `saml_utils.py` into `saml/{assertions,metadata,bindings}.py` behind a re-export shim; full suite green, ruff and mypy clean on `kestrel/` [1].

## What changed
- Maya approved and merged PR #418 (SAML assertion signature verification, Fernhill SSO) — it goes out with tonight's staging deploy [3].

## What is still open
- PR #423 (this cleanup): Tom requests changes — split the module move from the lint fixes into two PRs; he says he'll approve both today [4].
- Thursday 10am NY time: the Fernhill end-to-end SSO walkthrough on staging with their Okta tenant; Priya runs the demo, you just need to be on the call [1].
- The replay cache for assertion IDs is still in-memory per process: move it to Redis (`SET key NX EX`, keyed by tenant + assertion ID) for multi-pod [1][2].
